data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, **1Password Business** is my top recommendation. It offers an excellent balance of security, ease of use, shared credentials, and centralized administration without requiring a dedicated IT person.

However, the best choice depends on your team size, budget, and how much administrative control you need.

Here are the three I'd shortlist\:

## Best options for a small team

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password — Best overall**

(My top pick)

- Excellent shared vaults and permissions.
- Easy for non-technical employees.
- Strong admin controls and employee offboarding.
- Watchtower security alerts.
- Good for managing company logins, client accounts, and infrastructure credentials.

**Best for\:** Teams that want something polished and easy to manage.

Business: approximately US\$8.99/user/month. Teams Starter Pack is also available for up to 10 users.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden — Best value**

- Open-source core.
- Shared collections for team credentials.
- Strong security and administrative features.
- Supports self-hosting on suitable plans.
- Generally less expensive than 1Password.

**Best for\:** Technically comfortable teams that want excellent value.

Teams: approximately US\$4/user/month, billed annually.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper — Best for administrative control**

- Shared team folders.
- Role-based access.
- Detailed administrative controls.
- Additional security and compliance features.

**Best for\:** Teams with more formal security or compliance requirements.

Business pricing varies by plan and team size.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

These are approximate US-dollar reference prices, not Canadian-dollar quotes. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.northvetted.ca](https://www.northvetted.ca/reviews/best-password-manager-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[geekchamp.com](https://geekchamp.com/best-password-managers-for-small-business-teams-with-shared-access-controls/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to these two\:

| If you prioritize... | Choose |
|--------|--------|
| Ease of use and polished experience | 1Password |
| Lowest cost with strong features | Bitwarden |
| Advanced administrative controls | Keeper |


One additional consideration if you're operating in Canada: 1Password offers Canadian data residency, which may be useful if data-location requirements matter to your business. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.northvetted.ca](https://www.northvetted.ca/reviews/best-password-manager-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[geekchamp.com](https://geekchamp.com/best-password-managers-for-small-business-teams-with-shared-access-controls/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd look for regardless of provider

Make sure your plan includes\:

- Separate vaults for departments or projects.
- Granular permissions (not everyone sees everything).
- Easy removal of access when an employee leaves.
- Two-factor authentication.
- Audit logs and security alerts.
- Secure sharing of credentials without sending passwords through Slack or email.

## A couple of questions to narrow it down

How many people are on your team?
